jurisdiction_factory.title: CA Jurisdiction Factory v0.1
jurisdiction_factory.role: current governed jurisdiction identity and release-readiness source

nested_divisions.title: Nested Divisions
nested_divisions.role: canonical Census place identity and county/state-legislative nesting source

selection_rules: Use only CA Factory jurisdictions marked release_ready TRUE.
Bind each target to the exact seven-digit Census place GEOID in Nested Divisions.
Preserve all county, state-senate, and state-assembly nesting relationships as lists.
Use exact OCD division selectors; do not infer a replacement selector at run time.
This is a five-target portability smoke, not a statewide production selection.
notes: NAT-FAC-001 bounded California portability evidence. This manifest records source authority and selection provenance only; generated artifacts and acceptance evidence are produced by CI.
